t: Nokri sheyyesh lo challon patuach lemaboy
s: Nokri sheyyesh lo challon patuach lemaboy ubo seip echad: nokri haddar bemaboy, veyesh lo challon achore beto patuach lebiqa o leqarpep, apillu en bachallon ella d' tepachim al d' tepachim — eno oser al bene maboy, apillu maknis umotzi gemallim uqeronot derek hammaboy kol hayyom, mippene shechapetz yoter beoto sheppatuach lo meachorayv lebaddo, sheyyesh lo avir harbeh sham, venaaseh pitcho lemaboy keillu eno ragil bo, sheeno oser. Vehu sheyyesh babbiqa o baqqarpep yoter mibbet satayim, sheaviro rab. Abal bet satayim — qatan hu, veeno noach lo yoter mehammaboy. Veyisrael sheyyesh lo petach lammaboy upetach meacharayv laqqarpep, veshakach velo ereb — im haqqarpep yoter mibbet satayim oser al bene maboy, lepi sheen haqqarpep rauy lo lehishtammesh bo beshabbat, sheen metaltelin bo ella bed' ammot. Veim huqqap ledira, apillu hu yoter mibbet satayim — eno oser [veim hu bet satayim, ap shello huqqap ledira — eno oser], kevan shehaqqarpep rauy lo lehishtammesh bo bekelim sheshshabetu betoko. Abal kelim sheshshabetu babbayit — asur lehotziam letoko, kemo shennitbaer besimman shn"ch vesha"b:
